name: ko-law-benchmark-v0
description: A Korean legal evaluation dataset intended to measure model performance on tasks drawn from Korean statutes and legal practice, including question answering and case-related classification. It evaluates comprehension and application of legal rules in Korean language contexts and is useful for assessing domain-adapted models.
reputation: A community-uploaded Hugging Face benchmark aimed at legal-NLP development in Korean; adoption is modest and primarily within niche legal-NLP groups.
